title: Adding things up in a loop
summary: Declare the total before the loop, update it inside.

say.never: To add up numbers, keep a **running total**, like a tally on paper. The total box must be made *before* the loop. If you made it inside, it would reset to 0 on every pass and you'd lose your tally. Here someone reads 10 pages a day for a week, and `pages += 10` adds to the tally each day.
say.bit: An accumulator lives outside the loop so it isn't reset each pass; the loop adds to it.
